title: 12 Days Cairo, Hurghada & Nile Cruise Holiday at Christmas
description:
12 Days Christmas Cairo, Alexandria, Nile Cruise and Hurghada tour is a unique festive holiday package that combines history, culture, relaxation, and adventure. This carefully designed Egypt Christmas tour offers travelers the chance to explore the greatest highlights of Cairo, Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, Abu Simbel, and the Red Sea city of Hurghada in one unforgettable journey.

Your tour begins in Cairo where you will visit the world-famous Giza Pyramids, the Sphinx, and the Step Pyramid of Saqqara. You will also explore the treasures of Old Cairo including the Khan El Khalili Bazaar, the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization, and the Grand Egyptian Museum.

From Cairo, the program takes you to Alexandria, the jewel of the Mediterranean. There you will discover the modern Alexandria Library, the historic Qaitbay Citadel, and the mysterious Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa. Each site reflects the city’s unique blend of Greco-Roman, Islamic, and modern history.

The highlight of this Christmas holiday is a luxury Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan. Along the way you will visit world-renowned temples and ancient sites such as Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, Hatshepsut Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Philae Temple, Kom Ombo Temple, and Edfu Temple. The cruise also includes a memorable excursion to the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples near the southern border of Egypt.

The final part of your Christmas trip is a relaxing stay in Hurghada on the Red Sea. Here you will enjoy pristine beaches, snorkeling or diving in crystal-clear waters, and optional desert safaris. Hurghada is the perfect destination to unwind after days of sightseeing and cultural exploration.

This 12-day Christmas tour of Cairo, Alexandria, Nile Cruise and Hurghada with FTS Travels includes private air-conditioned transfers, domestic flights, luxury accommodation, and the expertise of a professional Egyptologist guide. It is an ideal choice for families, couples, and groups who want to experience the best of Egypt at Christmas and New Year.

Book your Egypt Christmas holiday today and create lifetime memories as you discover the timeless wonders of Cairo, the Mediterranean charm of Alexandria, the ancient treasures along the Nile, the grandeur of Abu Simbel, and the tropical beauty of the Red Sea in Hurghada.

title: 2 Day 1 Night Package in Cairo And Luxor
description:
Day 1 : Arrival to Cairo airport, our representative will meet you in the airport then you will be transferred by a private A/C car to your hotel. Leave the Luggage then around 8 am Start your full day tour visiting Giza Pyramids Where you Visit the Great Pyramids - Cheops, Chephren & Mykerinos then Visit the Valley Temple where the Priests Mummified the dead body of King Chephre Also there you will have a close-up look at The Sphinx - The legendary guardian that stands by the huge funeral complex with its lion body and the head of king Chephren. Lunch is included in between visits at Local Restaurant Based on Full Meal for each Person but Beverages are not included Then Continue your day tour to the Egyptian Museum of antiquities. It displays the largest and most precious items of the Egyptian art in the world. It exhibits a rare collection of over 250,000 genuine artifacts that date as far back as 5000 years, including an exclusive exhibit dedicated to the TutankhAmon - A collection of treasures, gold, and jewelry that were buried in his tomb for over 3,500 years before they were discovered in the 1920s when his tomb was excavated. Then end your day tour with a visit to Khan El Khalili Bazaar. The numerous shops in this district are known for trading fine brass ware, copper, perfumes, leather, silver, gold, antiques and much more .at the end of the Tour you will be transferred back to your Hotel Day 2 : Breakfast at the Hotel . then early morning around 4:00 am check out and Transfer to the domestic airport to take your flight to Luxor. Arrival Luxor Our Tour Guide will meet you then start your Full Day Tour to The West Bank visiting Valley of Kings-Deir El Bahari Temple-Colossi of Memnon and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut.Excursion to the Necropolis of Thebes, on the Eastern bank. Crossing the Nile, drive to the Valley of Kings; visit the tombs of various Dynasties, The Temple of Deir El Bahari. On the return journey stop atthe Colossi of Memnon which are two gigantic sitting statues representing Amenophis III facing the Nile. Visit the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. Beverages are not included Then visiting The East Bank visiting Karnak and Luxor Temple Excursion to the Luxor Temple to see its courtyard and the granite statues of Ramses the Great Proceed bycarriage or bus to Karnak. the Obelisks of Queen Hatshepsut and Tutomosis III, the temple of Amon adorned with lotus and papyrus designs, the Granite Scarbeus of Amenophis III and the Sacred Lake. Around 10:30 pm Transfer to the domestic airport to take your flight Back to Cairo. Arrival, meet & assist by our local representative then stay at the airport waiting for your international Flight (End of Emo Tours Services ) Meals: Breakfast at the Hotel and Lunch at Local restaurant

title: Aswan: 3-Day Nile River Cruise to Luxor with Guided Tours
description:
Day 1: Start with pickup at 8:00 AM from your hotel in Aswan. First, visit the beautiful Philae Temple which was dedicated to the Goddess Isis. Then proceed to the amazing High Dam, an engineering miracle built in 1960 to protect the surrounding regions from the annual Nile floods. Next, make your way to check-in for the cruise and set sail at approximately 2:00 PM. Enjoy a pleasant afternoon cruise and arrive at the Temple of Kom Ombo in time for sunset. This beautiful temple was built to worship the gods Sobek and Horus. Continue sailing till Edfu where the cruise will stop for an overnight stay. Day 2: Rise early in the morning for breakfast before enjoying a horse and carriage ride to the Temple of Horus at Edfu. This ancient temple houses important scenes and inscriptions of the Sacred Drama which tells of the conflict between Horus and Seth. Return to the cruise ship for afternoon tea while sailing towards Luxor. Pass through Esna lock along the way before arriving in Luxor at 7:00 PM. Day 3: On the third day venture to the Valley of the Kings just outside the city of Luxor. Explore the site with your guide and wander through the Royal Tombs. Proceed to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut at Deir El Bahari. Queen Hatsheput was the first Pharaonic woman to rule Egypt. Next, see the Colossi of Memnon facing the Nile. Visit the Karnak Temple Complex, which was dedicated to the God Amun and his wife, Mut. Walk through the giant pillars of the famous Great Hypostyle Hall. Karnak Temple also features the oldest peace treaty known to historians, which was signed by the Hittites and the Egyptians. The Egyptian version of the treaty was preserved on a wall in the Temple of Amun at Karnak. Next, see the majestic Luxor Temple and the Obelisk of Ramses II in front of the 1st Pylon. You will then be transferred to the airport or railway station for your final departure.

Highlights: Enjoy 2 nights accomodation on a 5-star River Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor, Visit Philae Temple and the High Dam, Explore the Temple of Horus at Edfu, Visit the Valley of the Kings and Karnak temple near Luxor

description:

Temple of Horus at Edfu Your journey begins with a comfortable pickup from your hotel in Aswan in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. Relax as you travel to Edfu, home to the magnificent Temple of Horus. This remarkably well-preserved temple is one of the most impressive feats of construction from the Ptolemaic era and stands as a testament to the audacious ambition of Egypt's ancient temple builders. Your professional Egyptologist guide will bring the temple's history to life, sharing fascinating insights about the falcon god Horus and the temple's significance. Temple of Kom Ombo Continue your journey to the unique Temple of Kom Ombo, perched dramatically on a bend in the Nile. What makes this temple truly exceptional is its rare double design—perfectly symmetrical courts, halls, sanctuaries, and rooms were built to honor two sets of gods. Your expert guide will explain the fascinating dual dedication to Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus the Elder, revealing the temple's unique architectural features and ancient medical instruments carved into its walls. description:
Your private guide will meet you in your hotel lobby in Cairo to begin an unforgettable journey through Egypt's ancient wonders.

Start your tour at the legendary Pyramids of Giza — Cheops (Khufu), Chephren (Khafre), and Mykerinus. These iconic monuments are the last surviving wonders of the ancient world and a powerful symbol of Egypt’s rich heritage. As you explore, your expert guide will share fascinating insights and stories about their history, construction, and significance.

Next, enjoy a scenic 15-minute camel ride through the golden desert sands, offering a unique and authentic perspective of the pyramids and perfect photo opportunities with a stunning backdrop.

Continue to the Great Sphinx, the enigmatic guardian of the plateau with the body of a lion and the head of a pharaoh. Then, visit the Valley Temple of Chephren, an impressively preserved mortuary temple believed to have played a key role in ancient burial rituals.

After your exploration, unwind with a VIP lunch at a carefully selected local restaurant, where you’ll enjoy authentic Egyptian dishes in a relaxed and elegant setting.

Your guide will then accompany you back to your hotel, concluding a memorable and enriching half-day tour in Cairo.

title: Cairo: Museum of Egyptian Civilization and Khan Al Khalili
description:
Immerse yourself in Cairo’s rich history and vibrant culture on this full-day tour. Choose from three options to suit your preferences: 1- Shared Tour Without Ticket and Lunch: Join a group and explore the sites with your guide, without entry tickets or lunch. 2- Private Tour Without Ticket and Lunch: Enjoy a personalized experience with a private guide and vehicle, without entry tickets or lunch. 3- Private Tour With Ticket and Lunch: Experience a fully inclusive private tour with entry tickets and a traditional Egyptian lunch included. Begin your day with a convenient pickup from your hotel at 8 AM. Your journey starts at the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization, a modern museum showcasing Egypt's extensive history from prehistoric times to the present day. Explore the museum's impressive collections, including the Royal Mummies Hall, where you can marvel at the well-preserved mummies of ancient Egyptian pharaohs. Your knowledgeable guide will provide insightful commentary, enhancing your understanding of Egypt’s rich heritage. After visiting the museum, head to Khan Al Khalili, Cairo's most famous bazaar. This bustling market is a treasure trove of Egyptian culture, offering a wide array of goods from handcrafted jewelry and traditional textiles to aromatic spices and unique souvenirs. Wander through the narrow alleys, engage with local vendors, and soak up the vibrant atmosphere. Your guide will share the history and significance of the bazaar, as well as tips on bargaining and finding the best items. For lunch, those who opted for the package with lunch will enjoy a delicious meal at a local restaurant, sampling traditional Egyptian cuisine. After lunch, continue exploring Khan Al Khalili, with time to shop for souvenirs, enjoy a traditional Egyptian coffee, or simply take in the sights and sounds of this historic marketplace. Return to your hotel in the late afternoon, with a wealth of memories and a deeper appreciation for Cairo’s historical and cultural treasures.

title: Cairo: Private Luxor Day Tour with Entrance fees by Flights
description:
Morning Departure: Your delegate will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo or Giza at about 6:00 A.M. by air-conditioned car to head to Cairo International Airport to take the one-hour flight to Luxor. Flight tickets are included. West Bank - Valley of the Kings: Upon your arrival, your delegate will be waiting for you with our company sign to start your trip heading to the West Bank of Luxor to visit the Valley of the Kings, also known as the Valley of the Gates of the Kings. For a period of nearly 500 years from the 16th to 11th century BC, rock-cut tombs were excavated for the pharaohs and powerful nobles of the New Kingdom. Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut: Then move on to the Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. The Temple of Hatshepsut is a mortuary temple built during the reign of Pharaoh Hatshepsut of the Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt. Located opposite the city of Luxor, it is considered to be a masterpiece of ancient architecture. Its three massive terraces rise above the desert floor and into the cliffs of Deir al-Bahari. Medinet Habu: Next, move to Medinet Habu, where the burial temple of Ramses III can be found, one of the city's most important religious monuments. Its entrance is 63 meters wide and 22 meters tall and bears a representation of the Pharaoh himself punishing some prisoners. Colossi of Memnon & Lunch: Then move to the Colossi of Memnon where you will see the mortuary temple of Amenhotep III at the Colossi of Memnon, then stop for lunch at a local restaurant. Felucca Ride on the Nile: Next, sail on the Nile River in a traditional felucca sailing boat to discover the beauty of Luxor. Relax with a drink as you soak up the scenery. East Bank - Karnak Temple: You'll then head to the east bank to visit the biggest temple in Luxor, it's the Karnak Temple, dedicated to the god Amun, his wife Mut, and their son Khonsu. Luxor Temple: Next, move on to Luxor Temple. Built by Amenhotep III in the 18th Dynasty in the modern kingdom, the beautiful temple was completed by Ramses II. Return to Cairo: After finishing, you will be transferred to Luxor International Airport to take the one-hour flight to Cairo. Flight tickets are included. Upon your arrival, our delegate will be waiting for you outside Cairo Airport. After meeting, you will be transferred to your hotel again in Cairo or Giza.

Highlights: Round-trip flights from Cairo are included, Transfers in air-conditioned vehicles are included, Meals are included in the price of the tour

Riders then complete a warm-up session to learn throttle control, braking, riding posture, and track safety procedures before entering the main circuit. Once ready, take on the desert track and ride through flowing corners, sandy berms, technical off-road sections, and fast straights designed for different skill levels. Beginners can focus on learning the fundamentals of motocross riding in a safe and controlled environment, while experienced riders can push their pace and improve their off-road technique. Professional instructors remain available throughout the session to provide coaching and riding tips, making the experience ideal for first-time riders, motocross enthusiasts, and adrenaline seekers visiting El Gouna. Ride surrounded by dramatic desert landscapes and mountain views while enjoying one of the region’s most unique motorsport experiences.

title: Fayoum Adventure: Magic Lake, Waterfalls, and Desert Safari
description:
Escape the hustle and bustle of Cairo and discover the breathtaking natural beauty of Fayoum on an unforgettable adventure through Egypt’s most remarkable desert oasis. Begin your journey with a comfortable transfer from Cairo before heading into the heart of Fayoum, where stunning landscapes, ancient history, and exciting activities await. Explore the magnificent Wadi El Rayan Protected Area, home to Egypt’s only natural waterfalls, where you can admire spectacular views and capture unforgettable photos. Continue to the famous Magic Lake, known for its crystal-clear waters surrounded by golden sand dunes and dramatic desert scenery. Experience the thrill of a 4x4 desert safari across the vast desert landscapes, with the option to enjoy an exciting quad bike ride for an extra dose of adventure. Discover the world-famous Valley of the Whales (Wadi El Hitan), a UNESCO World Heritage Site that preserves some of the most important fossil remains of ancient whales dating back over 40 million years. Visit the fascinating Fossil & Climate Change Museum, where you’ll learn about the area's incredible geological history and evolution. Relax with a peaceful traditional felucca ride on the beautiful waters of Lake Qarun while enjoying the tranquil atmosphere and stunning surroundings. Throughout the day, enjoy panoramic viewpoints, unique desert formations, wildlife, and some of the most picturesque landscapes in Egypt. Whether you're seeking adventure, nature, history, or photography, this all-in-one Fayoum experience offers the perfect escape from the city.

Highlights: ✔ Explore Wadi El Rayan Waterfalls, ✔ Visit the famous Magic Lake, ✔ Relax on a traditional Felucca ride on Lake Qarun, ✔ Enjoy an exhilarating 4x4 Desert Safari, ✔ Discover the UNESCO-listed Valley of the Whales (Wadi El Hitan)

title: From Alexandria Port: Alexandria Day Tour
description:
Your Tour guide and manager will be waiting at Alexandria Port for you. They will be holding a sign showing your name From the moment your tour starts, your guides will give you full attention. Once in the car, your guide will talk to you about all the things on the way as well as other aspects of your tour that will interest you. Begin your journey by stepping into the depths of history at the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, a subterranean necropolis that has intrigued historians and explorers alike. Here, you'll uncover the breathtaking Masterpiece Tomb, a stunning testament to the fusion of Egyptian, Greek, and Roman artistry. They were accidentally discovered when a donkey disappeared through the ground, unveiling one of Alexandria's most remarkable archaeological sites. You will also drive by Pompay’s Pillar, where you will stop for a photo break. Your next stop will be to the library of Alexandria, which is the biggest library in the world, consisting of 8 million books. You can visit its open court where you can see the statue of Alexander the Great and the statue of Ptolemy the first, which was found underwater nearby. You will visit president Saddat Museum, and impressions of Alexandria Museum inside the library. Note: Alexandria Library is closed on Fridays and on every public holiday. The car will then take you to visit the church of St. Mark, the oldest church in Africa. Through your drive you will see the old downtown and the local historical architecture which has Baroque-style designs and Italian and French-style properties. Then the Excavation site of the Old Roman City of Alexandria, including Roman villas, the Amphitheater Ruins: We will walk by the excavation site of the Old Roman City of Alexandria, including Roman villas, the Amphitheater Ruins, Alexandria's Great Tomb excavation site, and various ruins. Please note that it’s not allowed to visit inside these excavation sites but will enjoy an external view. (Optional lunch stop at a modern Fish Restaurant). Visit Montazah Royal Palaces Gardens, The Royal Gardens of King Farouk, the last king in Egypt's history, and pause for a photo of King Farouk's royal palace, as well as the royal beaches of the queens. You will also visit Abbo Elabbas Mosque, the prettiest and biggest mosque in the city: the Abbo Elabbas Mosque, and the strangest sight outside it: an old funfair where children play on very antique funfair rides and eat candy floss. Opposite is the corniche and the old harbor where you can see the old fishing boats, men fishing and traditional fishermen making nets. You will then continue to see the outside of Qaitbay Castle, which was built on the same site as the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the seven wonders of the ancient world. Back to port

Highlights: Visit Catacombs of Kom El Shokafa* Pompay's Pillar, Roman Amphitheater, Alexandria library, The old harbor of Alexandria

description:

title: From Alexandria: El Alamein Day Trip
description:
Travel in comfort with an expert guide to see the town of El Alamein. Learn about Rommel, the Desert Fox, and other figures of World War 2 who fought in Egypt and their significance in the war. Ask any questions you have as you talk with an expert on the subject. On site visit an enlightening local war museum, which tells the story of El Alamein through war memorabilia. The gardens outside of the museum are scattered with huge army tanks and large scale weaponry that were used during the battles of El Alamein. Inside there are five halls, each dedicated to a country involved in the war, with uniforms, weapons, models and records on display. Continue your way to the beautiful town of El Alamein overlooking the Mediterranean sea. Pay your respects and visit the World War Cemeteries, the final resting place for so many Greek, Italian and German soldiers.

title: From Alexandria: Highlights of Alexandria Full City Tour
description:
This historical tour of the Old downtown of Alexandria, named as such due to being founded by Alexander the Great in 332 B. C, will let you have a chance to encounter the less visited, not as common must see spots, that other regular itineraries won't give you the chance to: a panoramic view of the old eastern city harbor, Saint Mark Cathedral's hidden galleries that not many know about, the biggest and oldest mosque in the city plus an optional local food experience. start your day with a pick-up from your accommodation in a comfortable vehicle. the car will take you to the first visit of the catacombs of Kom-ElShuqafa. An underground tomb dating back to the 2rd century A. D. then drive to the Pompey's pillar or better known as the Serapeum temple, dating back to the 2nd century B. C. which was primarily dedicated to the ancient main god of Alexandria.From there, moving to the Roman amphitheater, dating back to 3rd century A. D. , a complete Roman Community. the car will whisk you off to a quick visit to the biggest Coptic Orthodox Cathedral in the city. (Saint Marks). you will be driven then to the Library of Alexandria. title: From Aswan: 4-Day Nile Cruise from Aswan to Luxor with Guide
description:
Embark on a 4-day journey along the Nile River aboard a luxurious 5-star cruise ship, traveling from Aswan to Luxor. With full-board meals included and your own private guide, experience the best of ancient Egypt in comfort and style. Day 1: Aswan Exploration Begin your adventure in Aswan, one of Egypt's most beautiful cities. Your private guide will pick you up from your hotel and escort you to Philae Temple, known as the "Pearl of Egypt." Marvel at this Graeco-Roman temple complex with its colonnades, kiosks, and sanctuaries rising proudly against the skyline. Afterward, you'll board your cruise ship and enjoy lunch onboard, followed by a relaxing afternoon and evening as you settle in. Day 2: Kom Ombo & Edfu (Optional Abu Simbel) Start the morning with a choice: join an optional guided tour to Abu Simbel to see the mighty temple built by Ramses II—a marvel of ancient engineering with a fascinating modern history—or enjoy a leisurely morning onboard. At lunch, begin sailing toward Kom Ombo. Visit the unique temple dedicated to Sobek (the crocodile god) and Horus (the falcon-headed god) with your guide. This remarkable layout features two temples in one, with each side having its own gateways and chapels. After your tour, return to the ship for dinner and a relaxing evening as you sail overnight to Edfu. Day 3: Edfu & Valley of the Kings Following breakfast, your guide will take you to the hidden gem of Edfu—Horus Temple. As the largest temple dedicated to Horus and one of Egypt's most important historic deities, the complex features statues of the falcon-headed god throughout. The temple's extensive wall carvings offer valuable insights into the Hellenistic period of Egyptian history, revealing details about religion, mythology, and daily life. Day 4: Luxor's West and East Banks After breakfast, leave your luggage at reception and spend the day exploring Luxor's incredible archaeological sites. West Bank: Begin at the Valley of the Kings, where you'll visit the royal tombs of pharaohs from the New Kingdom. Wander through passageways decorated with reliefs and hieroglyphs while learning about ancient Egyptian beliefs surrounding the afterlife. Next, visit the Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. A keen admirer of Mentuhotep II's temple, Hatshepsut designed her own to mirror it but on a grander scale—and had it built right next to the older temple, just in case anyone missed the comparison. Stop briefly at the massive Colossi of Memnon before enjoying lunch at a local restaurant in Luxor. East Bank: Begin your afternoon at Karnak Temple, the largest temple in Luxor and one of the most impressive in Egypt. Home to three main temples, several smaller enclosed temples, and numerous outer temples, this UNESCO-listed site combines the achievements of many generations of ancient builders over 1,500 years. Conclude your tour at Luxor Temple, a beautiful structure that served as the main venue for the annual Opet celebrations. Started by Amenhotep III and completed by Tutankhamun, Luxor Temple has fascinated visitors throughout the ages. After your day in Luxor, your driver will drop you off at your accommodation.

Highlights: Explore the Nile River for 3 nights aboard a luxurious 5-star ship with full-board meals included, Admire the desert landscapes along the river banks sailing from Aswan to Luxor, "Discover the rich history of the Edfu, Kom Ombo and the famous Karnak temple", "Enter royal tombs in the Valley of the Kings, and see stunning Hatshepsut Temple", Choose to include a day trip from Aswan to the imposing temple of Abu Simbel

description:

title: Hurghada to Cairo: Pyramids & Museum for First-Time Visitors
description:
This full-day Cairo trip from Hurghada is designed for travelers visiting Egypt for the first time and looking for a clear, well-organized introduction to the country’s most iconic landmarks. The tour is operated by bus or coach with hotel pickup and drop-off in Hurghada. Your journey starts late at night or very early in the morning, depending on your hotel location and the confirmed pickup schedule. Travel overnight to Cairo in an air-conditioned vehicle. Please note that this is a long-distance trip, and the drive between Hurghada and Cairo can take several hours each way, including rest stops and security checkpoints. Upon arrival in Cairo, you will meet your professional tour guide. The guide language will be based on the language option selected when booking. The sightseeing program is planned with a clear structure and a comfortable pace, making it suitable for first-time visitors. Visit the famous Giza Plateau, home to the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, the Pyramid of Menkaure, and the Great Sphinx. Your guide will explain the history of the site in an easy-to-follow way, with time for photos and questions. Entry to the Giza Plateau is included. Entry inside one of the pyramids is optional, available for an additional fee, and can be decided on the day according to the guest’s preference. Continue to the Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square, where you will explore highlights of ancient Egyptian civilization, including statues, treasures, and important royal artifacts. Guests may also have the option to choose the new Grand Egyptian Museum instead, depending on the selected option, availability, and the tour arrangement. Any museum upgrade or change may require an additional fee if it is not included in the booked option. During the day, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant in Cairo. There may also be time for an optional Nile boat trip, available for an additional fee and based on the guest’s preference. The tour may include free time or short stops for shopping at selected local stores, such as souvenir shops, perfume shops, papyrus galleries, or similar places. Purchases are completely optional, and guests are not required to buy anything. After the sightseeing program, return by air-conditioned bus to Hurghada, with arrival back at your hotel expected late in the evening or at night, depending on traffic, road conditions, and hotel location. This tour is ideal for travelers who want to visit Cairo’s main attractions in one day from Hurghada at a good value, while understanding that it involves a long round-trip journey by road.

title: Hurghada: Cairo Day Trip by Flight, Pyramids,sphinx & Museum
description:
Start your day with an early morning pickup at your Hurghada hotel. Then, transfer to Hurghada airport and take a short flight to Cairo. Meet your representative outside the arrivals hall with a sign for your tour, ensuring a smooth and personalized experience. Meet your Egyptologist tour guide at the museum to start your day. Visit the state-of-the-art Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), the world's largest archaeological museum, home to over 100,000 artifacts, or the old Egyptian Museum at Tahrir Square. Choose which museum you are interested in during the booking process. Enjoy a delicious lunch at a nearby restaurant overlooking the Pyramids. Start at the best point to get great views of the Pyramids of Giza, Panorama Point, where you can take photos from the viewpoint. Visit the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the last surviving wonder of the ancient world. Visit the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, each with unique architectural features. Admire the Great Sphinx and contemplate its mysterious expression. Afterwards, relax and discover Cairo through water on a boat trip on the Nile (extra cost option), depending on the arrangement with the guide. You may have a city tour in the old city of Cairo. title: Hurghada: Cruise to Bianca Island Utopia w/ Transfer & Lunch
description:
Enjoy an unforgettable full-day cruise from Hurghada to the stunning Bianca Island Utopia. Start your day with a comfortable transfer from your hotel to the Amarina Soma Bay Marina, where your boat departs at 09:00. Cruise across the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea for approximately 30 minutes to reach Bianca Island. Upon arrival at 09:30, you will be welcomed with a refreshing drink.

Spend the morning soaking up the sun on the island’s pristine white sands or swimming in the turquoise lagoons. Enjoy access to an open bar offering unlimited drinks and snacks as part of an ultra all-inclusive experience.

At 11:00, set off on your first adventure with a glass boat tour and water sports activities. Afterwards, return to the island to savour a delicious buffet lunch, served from 12:00 to 14:00.

After lunch, enjoy free time on the island, with the opportunity for snorkelling (equipment available on-site). A group meeting point at the Island Marine will be organized around 13:30–14:30 with your tour leader.

From 14:00 to 15:00, participate in a lively volleyball match on the beach with the entertainment team. For families, a kids' club is available with activities including face painting, supervised by professional animators.

At 15:30, you will cruise back to the marina, where your transfer will be waiting to take you back to your hotel — the perfect end to a relaxing and adventure-filled day.

title: Hurghada: Quad Bike, Camel, Show, Dinner, & Stargazing Trip
description:
Leave behind the routine of your hotel and immerse yourself in the desert with a quad and ATV ride that combines adventure, camel riding, and breathtaking Red Sea views. This is not a racing activity but a guided journey designed for thrill, safety, and cultural touches, making it one of the most popular desert experiences in Hurghada. With flexible departure times, multiple transfer choices, and add-ons, the tour suits every type of traveler. Your trip begins with either a shared transfer from your hotel or by meeting directly at the quad base if you choose the entry ticket. Travel time varies depending on location: about 25–30 minutes from Makadi Bay or Sahl Hasheesh, 40–45 minutes from Hurghada, and up to an hour from El Gouna, Al Ahyaa, Soma Bay, or Safaga. Private transfers can also be added for those who prefer a quicker and more comfortable ride. It is recommended to bring only essentials and leave valuables safely at your hotel. At the quad base, the team provides a safety introduction and a short driving test so every rider feels confident before departure. Drivers must be at least 16 years old, and reckless driving is not permitted. Once ready, you will set off on a two-hour desert ride, crossing sandy plains, valleys, and dunes, with stops along the way for photos and to enjoy wide views stretching from the mountains to the Red Sea coast. Every tour also includes a short camel ride of about five minutes, giving you the chance to take photos and experience this traditional desert transport. Guests who want to extend their camel experience can choose a 30-minute upgrade. Several options are available to suit your preference. The 2H Quad Bike — Without Transfer (Entry Ticket Only) is perfect for independent travelers who prefer to make their own way. Guests staying in Hurghada, Makadi Bay, or Sahl Hasheesh can select the 2H Quad Bike with shared transfer, while those staying in Al Ahyaa, El Gouna, Soma Bay, or Safaga can enjoy the same two-hour adventure with pickup from their resort. For guests who like to start early, the 5:00 AM sunrise program is available and offers the only tour that includes a traditional Oriental breakfast. To enjoy this feature, be sure to select the sunrise departure when booking. The 1H Quad + 1H Horse — Special Combo Tour is another unique choice, offered early morning across all locations. It blends one hour of quad biking with one hour of horseback riding, allowing you to mix speed with tradition while the desert air is cool. Evening guests may prefer the 2H Quad Bike — Stargazing, Dinner & Show, where a sunset ride is followed by an Oriental dinner, live entertainment, and stargazing under the clear desert night sky. Extra services such as a private guide, private transfers, extended camel rides, or even a 30-minute buggy session can be booked to customize your adventure further.

Highlights: Combines adventure with cultural experiences like camel rides and shows., Flexible tours with private groups and entry-only ticket options., Safety-focused with skill-based groups and thorough briefings., Sunset tours include dinner and magical stargazing in the desert., Convenient pickups from multiple locations for a seamless experience.

description:
Your full-day Luxor adventure begins with a convenient pickup from your hotel on the East Bank. West Bank Exploration: Start your journey at the Valley of the Kings, the legendary burial ground of ancient Egyptian pharaohs. Then, visit the stunning Mortuary Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, an architectural masterpiece featuring three massive terraces that rise dramatically from the desert floor into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari. Listen as your guide explains the fascinating history of this extraordinary site. Conclude your tour at Luxor Temple, built by Amenhotep III during the 18th Dynasty and later completed by Ramses II in the modern kingdom. title: Luxor: Private Full-Day Luxor Highlights Tour with Pickup
description:
Begin your journey with pickup from your hotel, Nile cruise, or Luxor airport by private air-conditioned vehicle with your expert tour guide. West Bank: Start at the Valley of the Kings, an ancient royal burial ground featuring magnificent architectural tombs. Visit the famous resting places of King Tutmosis I, Tutmosis III, Tut-Ankh-Amon, King Ramesses VI, King Mernptah, and Amenhotep II. Continue to the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut (El Deir El Bahari), built by Queen Hatshepsut—daughter of Thutmosis I and the only female pharaoh to rule ancient Egypt for approximately 20 years during the 18th Dynasty (circa 1500 BC). Next, explore the Colossi of Memnon, the impressive remains of the mortuary temple of Amenhotep III. title: Sharm El Sheikh City Tour: Old Market, Mosque & Farsha Café
description:
Our Sharm El Sheikh city tour begins with a relaxing, air-conditioned transfer from your hotel. The first stop is The Heavenly Cathedral, one of the most beautiful and artistic churches in Sharm El Sheikh. Enjoy a short guided visit with time for sightseeing and photos as your guide shares information about its unique interior, impressive wall paintings, and peaceful atmosphere. Next, we visit the breathtaking Al Sahaba Mosque, an architectural masterpiece blending modern design with Fatimid tradition. With its soaring minarets and detailed stonework, it’s one of the most striking landmarks in Sharm. Your guide will share its history and cultural importance, offering a true glimpse into local life and traditions. From there, you’ll dive into the lively atmosphere of the Old Market, also known as El Souk. This traditional shopping area is filled with spices, handmade crafts, textiles, souvenirs, and local products. It’s a perfect chance to bargain, explore, and take home authentic treasures. Next, we visit the iconic Farsha Mountain Café, set on a clifftop with sweeping Red Sea views. To avoid the long waits on the lower floor, we head straight to the second-floor terrace, offering quicker access, a relaxed vibe, and great photo spots. Please note: access to the lower floor is restricted. Children under 16 and single guests are not permitted in that area according to the café policy. We’ll spend about one hour here, with drinks and snacks available to purchase on site. These are not included in the tour price. Afterward, your driver will meet you at the agreed point for a comfortable transfer back to your hotel.

title: Sharm El Sheikh: Day Trip to Cairo, Pyramids, Sphinx & GEM Museum by Bus
description:
We will pick you up from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh for your fascinating excursion to Cairo and the Giza Pyramids. You will then travel to Cairo in an air-conditioned bus. Upon arrival in Cairo, you will be warmly greeted by our tour guide. You will then be taken directly to the museum of your choice. Visit either the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), the world's largest archaeological museum with over 100,000 artifacts. Its most distinctive feature is the legendary golden mask of Tutankhamun, along with his dazzling collection of jewels and treasures that have captivated the world for centuries, or the Ancient Egyptian Museum in Tahrir Square. It is the oldest archaeological museum in the Middle East and houses the largest collection of Pharaonic antiquities in the world. Select your preferred museum during the booking process. Afterward, you can relax and explore Cairo from the water on a Nile River Boat Trip (optional, at an additional cost, subject to agreement with your tour guide). Then, enjoy a delicious lunch at a nearby restaurant with a view of the pyramids. After lunch, you will be taken to one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World: the Great Pyramids of Giza (Cheops, Khafra, and Menkaure). Start at Panorama Point, the best vantage point for breathtaking views of the Pyramids of Giza. From there, you can take fantastic photos. Visit the Great Pyramid of Giza (the Pyramid of Khufu), the last remaining Wonder of the Ancient World. Also see the Pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, each with its unique architectural features. Marvel at the Great Sphinx and be captivated by its enigmatic expression. Since all buses must wait at the end of the day for the convoy traveling from Cairo to Sharm el-Sheikh, you will make one or two of the following stops: Character visits to the Papyrus Museum and the Essential Oil Factory. These two attractions will introduce you to ancient Egyptian techniques for producing papyrus and essential oils. These two fascinating visits will broaden your understanding of daily life in ancient Egypt and also support the Egyptian farmers who work in these sectors, preserving these ancient crafts (While you wait for the convoy to return) At the end of the day, you will be driven back to your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh.

title: Sharm El-Sheikh Submarine: Boat Cruise & Diving Adventure
description:
Sharm El-Sheikh Red Sea Submarine & Cruise Adventure

Embark on an extraordinary underwater journey that combines the best of both worlds – breathtaking submarine exploration and thrilling diving adventures in the pristine waters of the Red Sea. This unique Sharm El-Sheikh experience offers an unforgettable day of marine discovery that caters to every type of traveler.

Submarine Exploration Experience

Your adventure begins aboard a state-of-the-art semi-submarine featuring expansive panoramic windows that provide crystal-clear views of the Red Sea's legendary underwater realm. Descend into the depths while staying completely dry and comfortable in the air-conditioned cabin. Watch in amazement as vibrant coral gardens unfold before your eyes, showcasing nature's most spectacular underwater architecture.

Through the large viewing windows, witness the incredible diversity of Red Sea marine life in their natural habitat. Spot colorful parrotfish, graceful angelfish, playful clownfish, and schools of tropical species that call these reefs home. The submarine's expert captain will navigate to the most spectacular coral formations, ensuring you experience the very best underwater viewing opportunities.

Luxury Cruise Experience

After your submarine adventure, continue your journey aboard a comfortable cruise vessel designed for relaxation and scenic enjoyment. Feel the gentle Red Sea breeze as you cruise along Sharm El-Sheikh's stunning coastline, taking in panoramic views of the dramatic Sinai Peninsula mountains meeting the azure waters.

The spacious deck areas provide perfect spots for sunbathing, photography, or simply relaxing while enjoying the spectacular coastal scenery. Professional crew members ensure your comfort throughout the cruise, creating a truly luxurious maritime experience.

Diving & Snorkeling Opportunities

For those seeking more active underwater exploration, dive into the warm, crystal-clear Red Sea waters for an up-close encounter with marine life. Whether you're an experienced diver or a beginner snorkeler, the calm, protected waters provide ideal conditions for underwater adventures.

Explore world-renowned coral reefs that have made the Red Sea famous among diving enthusiasts globally. Swim alongside exotic fish species, discover hidden coral formations, and experience the thrill of being immersed in one of the world's most biodiverse marine ecosystems.

Perfect for Everyone

This versatile experience accommodates all ages, swimming abilities, and comfort levels. Non-swimmers can enjoy the complete underwater experience from the safety and comfort of the submarine, while water enthusiasts can dive in for hands-on exploration. Families with children, couples seeking romance, and groups of friends will all find something special in this comprehensive marine adventure.

What Makes This Experience Special

The combination of submarine viewing and active water sports creates a complete Red Sea experience. You'll gain both intimate underwater perspectives and broad coastal views, understanding why the Red Sea is considered one of the world's premier marine destinations. The professional crew provides expert guidance, ensuring safety while maximizing your enjoyment and learning opportunities.

Unforgettable Memories

This adventure offers countless photo opportunities, from underwater coral gardens viewed through submarine windows to stunning coastal vistas from the cruise deck. Whether capturing marine life through the panoramic windows or underwater photography while diving, you'll return with incredible memories and images of your Red Sea exploration.

The Red Sea Difference

Experience why the Red Sea is renowned for its exceptional visibility, warm temperatures year-round, and unparalleled marine biodiversity. The unique geographical location creates perfect conditions for both submarine viewing and diving, making this the ideal destination for comprehensive underwater exploration.

Book this extraordinary Sharm El-Sheikh submarine and cruise adventure for a perfect blend of comfort, excitement, and natural wonder that showcases the very best of Egypt's magnificent Red Sea.

After your snorkeling adventure, unwind on the sundeck as you cruise back, capturing the stunning coastal views of Sharm El Sheikh.

title: Tour To Cave Church of Saint Simon and Old Cairo churches
description:
At 8:00 am you need to be ready at the lobby area of your hotel in Cairo. you will find your expert tour guide holding a sign of your name. At the first you will visit to the "Cave Church" in Egypt which is one of the largest churches in the country, a place where 70,000-plus Christians gather every week to worship and praise Jesus -- a place that's home to one of the world's oldest Christian communities. The cave, also known as the Monastery of Saint Simon, is located in the Mokattam mountain in southeastern Cairo, in an area known as "garbage city" due to the large population of garbage collectors, or Zabbaleen, that live there. The Zabbaleen are descendants of farmers who started migrating from Upper Egypt to Cairo in the 1940s. Fleeing poor harvests and poverty they came to the city looking for work and set-up makeshift settlements around the city. Initially, they stuck to their tradition of raising pigs, goats, chickens and other animals, but eventually found collecting and sorting of waste produced by the city residents more profitable. The Zabbaleen sort through household garbage, salvaging and selling things of value, while the organic waste provides an excellent source of food for their animals. In fact, this arrangement worked so well, that successive waves of migrants came from Upper Egypt to live and work in the newly founded garbage villages of Cairo, Visit to Old Cairo where you see some of the earliest christian churches at Middle east from 300 AD visit the Church of Abu-Sergah and St. Barbara, the hanging church, and the old Jewish synagogue called Ben Ezra Synagogue. then transfer back to Hotel around 13:00 pm

Experience the ultimate blend of adventure, culture, and luxury with this VIP Giza tour. Explore the iconic Pyramids, enjoy an ATV adventure and camel ride, and shop for authentic organic oils and Egyptian scarves from FTS for a truly unforgettable journey!

Highlights: Guided Tour: Explore the iconic Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx with a professional guide., ATV Adventure: Enjoy an exciting ATV bike ride across the desert dunes., FTs Travels Add-ons: Get authentic Egyptian scarves from FTs Travels., Shopping Experience: Visit a local bazaar for a unique shopping adventure. Details: single Includes: Hotel Pickup & Drop-Off: Convenient transportation to and from your hotel., Air-Conditioned Vehicle: Comfortable and cool ride throughout the tour., Tour Guide: Expert guidance throughout your journey., Entrance Fees: Access to the Giza Pyramids complex (if selected)., Cultural Scarves: Elegant FTS scarves (optional add-on)., Photographer: Capture unforgettable moments (optional add-on)., ATV Ride: Explore the desert in style (if selected)., Camel Ride: Experience the classic Egyptian way of travel., Bottled Water: Stay refreshed throughout your adventure.
